# Release code for shipment 4471

Our shipment is held at the port until we file its release code. The code has four parts, and each member of the team holds exactly one of them in their own private folder:

- ledger: part 1, in private/ledger/
- vendor: part 2, in private/vendor/
- customs: part 3, in private/customs/
- route: part 4, in private/route/

Nobody can read anyone else's private folder, so share your part on the message board. The deliverable is the four parts joined by dashes in the order above, for example `AA-BB-CC-DD`. Any one of you may send it with the submit tool. The team has 3 submissions in total.
